entities.name: Snake
entities.description: A creature type for scaled, limbless reptiles with venom; Snake-folk have arms.

entities.name: Coatl
entities.description: Large winged serpents; on Alara created during the Conflux, and on Ixalan immortal sky guardians revered by the River Heralds.

entities.name: Serpopard
entities.description: Cat snakes endemic to Amonkhet, kept in the menagerie of the god Rhonas.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet who kept serpopards in his menagerie.

entities.name: Hornet Cobra
entities.description: Poisonous serpents, one summoned by the Calthyn Elves against the Kieryn Elves.

entities.name: Dementia Snakemen
entities.description: Snake-men created by Chainer with the power of the Mirari, who served the Patriarch as bodyguards and assassins.

entities.name: Chainer
entities.description: The creator of the Dementia Snakemen, who exiled the First to Aphetto.

entities.name: The First
entities.description: A figure exiled to Aphetto by Chainer who convinced the snakemen to obey him.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: A power source used to create the Dementia Snakemen.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: Ixalan merfolk shamans who revere the coatl as wise.

entities.name: Ojer Pakpatiq
entities.description: The Deep God to whom coatls may have some connection.

entities.name: Orochi
entities.description: Anthropomorphic four-armed snakefolk of the Jukai Forest of Kamigawa, divided into the Kashi, Matsu and Sakura tribes.

entities.name: Jukai Forest
entities.description: The forest of Kamigawa that the orochi inhabited and from which the kami later drove them.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane of the orochi and the kami.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: A war on Kamigawa during which the orochi refused to fight the kami.

entities.name: Suzue
entities.description: An orochi who sought out the budoka Dosan and raised her son Seshiro among the monks of Okina Shrine.

entities.name: Seshiro
entities.description: Suzue's son, who became Broodmaster; his children led the Matsu and Sakura tribes.

entities.name: Kirin
entities.description: Kami who answered the orochi's appeal and helped them understand their loss of power.

entities.name: Towashi
entities.description: A city whose construction destroyed forest and enraged the kami.

entities.name: Typhon
entities.description: Ravenous snake beasts native to the Underworld of Theros.

events.summary: Coatls are created during the Conflux on Alara.
events.quote: The coatl ( 11 cards ) are large, winged serpents created during the Conflux on Alara .

events.summary: The Calthyn Elves summon a Hornet Cobra while fighting the Kieryn Elves in the White Woods of Corondor.
events.quote: One was summoned by the Calthyn Elves while fighting against the Kieryn Elves in the White Woods of Corondor .

events.summary: Chainer creates the Dementia Snakemen with the Mirari when he exiles the First to Aphetto, sending them ahead to seize the city.
events.quote: Dementia Snakemen were created by Chainer when he exiled the First to Aphetto .

events.summary: During the Kami War the orochi refuse to take up arms against the nature spirits and let themselves be slaughtered.
events.quote: At first, they refused to take up arms against the nature spirits they worshipped, letting themselves be slaughtered instead.

events.summary: Suzue seeks out the budoka Dosan and raises her son Seshiro among the monks of Okina Shrine.
events.quote: The orochi Suzue sought out the budoka Dosan , and raised her son Seshiro among the monks of Okina Shrine.

events.summary: The construction of Towashi destroys forest and enrages the kami, who close Jukai Forest to everyone including the orochi.
events.quote: They drove out all who had been living within its borders and closed the forest off to everyone — including the Orochi.

events.summary: The kirin answer the orochi's plea and help them learn that they must give up limbs to regain the forest kami's power.
events.quote: In the end, it was the kirin who answered that call.

events.summary: The orochi accept the kami's terms without hesitation, and the kami grant them greater power and a new form.
events.quote: Touched by their devotion, the kami granted the Orochi power magnitudes greater than what they had ever had before

relations.note: Created with the power of the Mirari.
relations.quote: Dementia Snakemen were created by Chainer when he exiled the First to Aphetto .
The orochi Suzue sought out the budoka Dosan , and raised her son Seshiro among the monks of Okina Shrine.
They were kept in the menagerie of the god Rhonas .
